get_optimizers_from_groups: get a list of optimizers from named groups like basics or cma with optional seed shuffling
register_optimizer_group: register a new optimizer group function that returns a sequence of optimizer names or configured optimizers
get_split_optimizer_configs: get configured split optimizer instances for CMA ECMA DE and TwoPointsDE with varying num_optims values
get_progressive_optimizer_configs: get progressive split optimizer configs using ParametrizedOnePlusOne with discrete or gaussian mutation strategies
get_anisotropic_progressive_configs: get anisotropic progressive optimizer configs for CMA ECMA DE PSO and NoisyRL variants with split optimization
